m: दाधिक mf(ई)n. (fr. दधि) made of or mixed or sprinkled with coagulated milk, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 18; 3, 22. 26
eating anything with it, Siddh.; ib.
दाधिक m. N. of a princely race
दाधिक n. a kind of broth, Suśr.
a: दाधिक — a. (की f.) 1 Made of or from, or mixed or sprinkled with, coagulated milk. --2 Carrying about or selling coagulated milk. --3 Eating anything with coagulated milk. --कं A kind of broth.

m: दाधित्थ mf(ई)n. (fr. दधित्थ) relating to Feronia Elephantum, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 140, Kāś.
